name: What is involved in the new roof installation process?
description: The process involves removing the old roof, inspecting decking, installing underlayment and flashing, applying new material, and cleanup.

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the new roof installation process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The new roof installation process typically begins with a thorough inspection and removal of the old roofing material. Next, the underlying decking is inspected and repaired if necessary, followed by the installation of underlayment for added protection. Flashing is installed around chimneys, vents, and other penetrations to prevent leaks. Finally, the new roofing material is applied according to manufacturer specifications and local building codes. A final cleanup concludes the project.
